sloka: श्रेणयस्त्वां महाराज पश्यन्त्वग्र्याश्च सर्वश: ।प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यं राज्ये स्थितमरिन्दमम् ॥ २.१०५.११॥
transliteration: śreṇayastvāṁ mahārāja paśyantvagryāśca sarvaśa: ।pratapantamivādityaṁ rājye sthitamarindamam ॥ 2.105.11॥

translations.english: O great king and subduer of enemies, may all the leading guilds of traders and other subjects behold you all over installed in the kingdom like the resplendent Sun.
